summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Pipeline Info Button and Background Sponsorship Caching feature. Backend: 12/12 tests pass (100%). Backend: Free tier users get 403 when trying to update outreach status
Backend: Invalid status values are rejected with 400
Backend: Successful outreach status update returns {success: true, status, log_entry}
Backend: GET /api/channels/{channel_id}/sponsorship-data requires authentication
Backend: Sponsorship data endpoint returns correct structure (is_sponsored_active, confidence_score, etc.)
Backend: Follow-up date update endpoint works correctly
Backend: Channel notes update endpoint works correctly
Backend: GET /api/channels/by-outreach-status returns channels list with status_counts
Backend: Pipeline filter by status works correctly
Backend: BackgroundTasks parameter accepted by outreach-status endpoint
Backend: Sponsorship data is cached and available after pipeline entry
Frontend: Info button visible on each channel row in Pipeline page (data-testid=info-btn-{channel_id})
Frontend: Clicking Info button opens Channel Detail Sheet (data-testid=pipeline-channel-detail-sheet)
Frontend: Score Breakdown section shows Total and Affiliate scores with detailed breakdown
Frontend: Outreach Tracking section with Status select (data-testid=pipeline-detail-outreach-status-select)

Frontend: Contact Log displays previous status changes with timestamps

Frontend: Statistics section shows subscribers, avg views, video count, last upload

critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly implements BackgroundTasks for sponsorship auto-caching when channel enters pipeline
The _cache_sponsorship_data function properly fetches YouTube data and stores via detect_sponsorships()
ChannelDetailSheet component is well-structured with proper data-testid attributes for testing
Outreach status update correctly triggers background task only when: was_not_contacted AND is_entering_pipeline AND has_no_cache
Free tier users can view empty Pipeline page but backend correctly returns 403 on any status update attempt
seed_data_creation: Used existing test users and channels already in pipeline from previous testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 14 tested Pipeline Info Button and Background Sponsorship Caching feature. The Info button is visible on each channel row in the Pipeline page (/dashboard/pipeline) with data-testid='info-btn-{channel_id}'. Clicking it opens a ChannelDetailSheet component with sections: Score Breakdown, Outreach Tracking (status select, follow-up date, contact notes), Affiliate Potential, Statistics, Channel Health, Tags & Signals, Brand Intelligence (with sponsorship confidence badge and videos with disclosures), and Notes. Backend endpoint PATCH /api/channels/{channel_id}/outreach-status now accepts BackgroundTasks parameter and triggers _cache_sponsorship_data when a channel transitions from not_contacted to another status and has no cached sponsorship_data. All 12 backend tests pass. All frontend interactions work correctly - status updates, contact notes, follow-up dates, notes textarea (saves on blur), and sheet closing.
